<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[2026 Iran war ceasefire]]
*****[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian foreign minister]] [[Abbas Araghchi]] confirms the two-week [[ceasefire]] between [[Iran]] and the [[United States]], which includes [[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis|reopening]] the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. The ceasefire is ratified by the [[Supreme National Security Council]] (SNSC). [https://shafaq.com/en/Middle-East/Iran-agrees-to-ceasefire-offers-conditional-Hormuz-passage (Shafaq)] [https://www.khaleejtimes.com/world/mena/iran-agrees-to-safe-passage-through-hormuz-strait-for-two-weeks-if-attacks-halted-2 (''Khaleej Times'')]
*****The SNSC announces that negotiations between Iran and the U.S. will start on Friday in [[Islamabad]], [[Pakistan]], with the U.S. contingent to be led by [[Vice President of the United States|vice president]] [[JD Vance]] alongside [[Senior Advisor to the President of the United States|senior presidential adviser]] [[Jared Kushner]] and [[United States Special Envoy|special envoy]] [[Steve Witkoff]]. [https://www.axios.com/2026/04/08/us-iran-peace-talks-vance-pakistan-saturday (''Axios'')] [https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/iran-says-talks-us-begin-friday-islamabad?topic=War%2520on%2520Iran&id=436636&fid=553792 (''Middle East Eye'')]
*****[[Israel]]i [[Prime Minister of Israel|prime minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] and [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] both claim that the ceasefire does not include [[Lebanon]], despite contrary statements from both Iran and Pakistan on their versions of the ceasefire agreement. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/8/netanyahu-says-us-iran-ceasefire-does-not-include-lebanon (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0j6d538l6qo (BBC News)]  [https://www.nytimes.com/2026/04/08/world/middleeast/jd-vance-lebanon-iran-cease-fire.html (''The New York Times'')]
*****[[White House press secretary]] [[Karoline Leavitt]] states that Netanyahu and Trump will continue discussions on potentially including Lebanon in a ceasefire arrangement. [https://english.aaj.tv/news/330456642/trump-will-continue-to-discuss-lebanon-with-israeli-pm-white-house (AFP via Aaj News)]
*****After the announcement, an [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] spokesperson states that Israel is still launching attacks on Iran. [https://edition.cnn.com/2026/04/07/world/live-news/iran-war-trump-us-israel?post-id=cmnpbvjkq00003b6re2vy4p6y (CNN)]
*****[[President of Iran|Iranian president]] [[Masoud Pezeshkian]] says the ceasefire with Israel and the U.S. has been violated as a result of the bombings of Iranian islands and Lebanon. [[Iranian parliament]]ary speaker [[Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf]] later echoes the remarks, citing the attacks as well as the "denial of Iran to [[uranium enrichment|enrich uranium]]." [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/08/ceasefire-iran-war-lebanon.html (CNBC)] [https://www.forbes.com/sites/saradorn/2026/04/08/iran-closes-strait-of-hormuz-blames-israels-massive-attack-on-lebanon-putting-ceasefire-in-doubt/ (''Forbes'')] [https://g1.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/04/08/presidente-do-ira-diz-que-cessar-fogo-foi-rompido-com-ataques-a-ilhas-iranianas.ghtml (G1)]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Arab countries]]
****[[2026 Iranian strikes on Bahrain]]
*****The [[Bahrain Defence Force|Bahraini military]] intercepts six missiles and 31 drones. [https://www.yemenonline.info/gulf-news/12251 (''Yemen Online'')]
****[[2026 Iranian strikes on Kuwait]]
*****[[Kuwait]]'s [[Ministry of Interior (Kuwait)|interior ministry]] reports fires at several [[Petroleum industry in Kuwait|oil facilities]], [[Energy in Kuwait|power plants]], and [[Desalination by country#Kuwait|desalination]] plants after an [[Unmanned aerial vehicles in the Iranian military|Iranian drone]] attack. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/kuwait-reports-damage-oil-facilities-power-stations-after-iranian-drone (''Middle East Eye'')]
****[[2026 Iranian strikes on Qatar]]
*****The [[Qatar Armed Forces|Qatari military]] intercepts seven ballistic missiles and multiple drones. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/articles/qatar-reports-rocket-drone-attacks-163721442.html (DPA via Yahoo News)]
****[[2026 Iranian strikes on Saudi Arabia]]
*****[[Saudi Arabia]]'s [[East–West Crude Oil Pipeline]] is hit in an Iranian attack. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/saudi-arabias-east-west-oil-pipeline-hit-iranian-attack-damage-being-assessed-2026-04-08/ (Reuters)]
****[[2026 Iranian strikes on the United Arab Emirates]]
*****The [[United Arab Emirates Armed Forces|Emirati military]] intercepts 17 ballistic missiles and 35 drones. [https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uae/2026/04/08/uae-intercepts-17-ballistic-missiles-and-35-drones-in-wednesdays-figures/ (''The National'')]
****After the announcement of a ceasefire, Iran launches [[Ballistic missile program of Iran|ballistic missile]]s at [[Bahrain]], Israel, [[Kuwait]], [[Qatar]], and the United Arab Emirates. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/08/iran-missile-attacks-after-us-ceasefire-gulf-air-defenses.html (CNBC News)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2026/04/07/world/live-news/iran-war-trump-us-israel?post-id=cmnpbvjkq00003b6re2vy4p6y (CNN)]
****Iranian agencies report explosions from the [[Lavan Island|Lavan]] and [[Sirri Island|Sirri island]]s of unknown origin. Iran accuses Kuwait and the UAE of the attacks and launches retaliatory attacks against those countries in response. [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/1cje8v7cv (Ynet)] [https://wanaen.com/strikes-hit-lavan-refinery-iran-launches-retaliatory-attacks/ (Wanaen)]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[Thailand]] confirms the three crewmen on [[Mayuree Naree (2007)|a vessel]] that was attacked in the [[Strait of Hormuz]] in March have died. [https://aje.news/jf7llm?update=4473051 (Al Jazeera)]
****[[MarineTraffic]] reports the first ships that have passed through the Strait of Hormuz since the ceasefire announcement, namely the [[Greece|Greek]]-owned [[bulk carrier]] ''NJ Earth'' and [[Liberia]]-flagged ''Daytona Beach''. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/08/trump-iran-ceasefire-strait-of-hormuz-toll.html (CNBC)] [https://www.euronews.com/business/2026/04/08/greek-and-liberian-flagged-ships-first-to-transit-hormuz-since-ceasefire (Euronews)]
****Iran closes Strait of Hormuz maritime traffic to oil tankers over [[2026 Lebanon war|Israeli attacks in Lebanon]], claiming that Lebanon is included in the ceasefire. [https://g1.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/04/08/ira-ameaca-romper-cessar-fogo-se-israel-continuar-atacando-o-libano.ghtml (G1)] [https://www.forbes.com/sites/saradorn/2026/04/08/iran-closes-strait-of-hormuz-blames-israels-massive-attack-on-lebanon-putting-ceasefire-in-doubt/ (''Forbes'')]
***Bahrain, [[Iraq]], and [[Syria]] reopen their airspace after weeks of closure. The [[Damascus International Airport]] and the [[Bahrain International Airport]] begin resuming flights. [https://www.khaleejtimes.com/world/gulf/bahrain-reopens-airspace-april-8-2026?fbclid=IwY2xjawRDgelleHRuA2FlbQIxMQBzcnRjBmFwcF9pZAwzNTA2ODU1MzE3MjgAAR4NgnlyBYM4AeXeico6iJLFkmsjREnNBbge_OzY0Rc2uvOIKLOTVOo4kx0R8Q_aem_kBWmchV7ui7DGKiSZhWKUg (''Khaleej Times'')] [https://www.bna.bh/en/BahrainInternationalAirportbeginsgradualresumptionofflights.aspx?cms=q8FmFJgiscL2fwIzON1%2bDi5%2fzrQw%2fM5fdGEOHryUWgE%3d (BNA)] [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/syria-iraq-bahrain-reopen-airspace-after-us-iran-ceasefire-agreement-announced/3898806 (AA)]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)|Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****[[2026 Israeli Beirut strikes]]
*****At least 254 people are killed and 1,165 others are injured in a wave of [[Israel]]i strikes on [[Lebanon]], including in [[southern Lebanon]], [[Beirut]], and the [[Bekaa Valley]]. [https://aje.news/jf7llm?update=4474525 (Al Jazeera)]  [https://aje.news/jf7llm?update=4473570 (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0j6d538l6qo (BBC News)]
****The IDF announces that its strikes in Lebanon are one part of a new operation it is calling "Eternal Darkness". [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/buf6bj7sg (Ynet)]
****The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] says that it has halted strikes against Iran, but state that they will continue fighting [[Hezbollah]] in Lebanon. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-says-it-has-halted-strikes-in-iran-continues-fighting-hezbollah-in-lebanon/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
****The [[Lebanese Armed Forces|Lebanese army]] closes a bridge in the [[Tyre District]] after receiving a warning of a possible Israeli strike on the structure. The bridge is the last crossing linking areas north and south of the [[Litani River]] in the area, where many residents remain despite evacuation notices. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/lebanese-army-closing-last-bridge-over-litani-river-after-israeli-threat-to-target-it/ (AFP via ''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
***[[Gaza war]]
****[[Killing of journalists in the Gaza war]]
*****An Israeli airstrike in [[Sheikh Ijlin]], [[Gaza City]], [[Palestine]], kills two people, including [[Al Jazeera Media Network|Al Jazeera]] correspondent Mohammed Wishah. [https://globalnation.inquirer.net/317496/al-jazeera-condemns-killing-of-journalist-in-israeli-strike-on-gaza (AFP via ''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
*[[Afghanistan–Pakistan border skirmishes]]
**[[2026 Afghanistan–Pakistan conflict]]
***[[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (China)|Chinese foreign ministry]] spokesperson [[Mao Ning (diplomat)|Mao Ning]] says that [[Afghanistan]] and [[Pakistan]] has agreed on a comprehensive plan to end tensions after seven days of talks in [[Ürümqi]], [[China]]. The two countries also agree to avoid any escalations in their [[2026 Afghanistan–Pakistan conflict|current conflict]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/afghanistan-pakistan-agree-to-avoid-escalation-china (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/china-says-afghanistan-pakistan-agree-explore-comprehensive-solution-peace-talks-2026-04-08/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] threatens to impose 50% [[tariff]]s on countries that supply military weapons to Iran. [https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2026/04/08/trump-threatens-tariffs-countries-supplying-weapons-iran-ceasefire.html (CNBC)]
**[[Denmark|Danish]] [[Freight transport|shipping]] company [[Maersk]] says that they will take a "cautious approach" for [[List of ships owned by Maersk|vessels]] to cross the [[Strait of Hormuz]] despite the ceasefire and says that they have not provided security certainty as to when normal operations would resume. [https://www.reuters.com/world/maersk-says-us-iran-ceasefire-may-create-strait-hormuz-transit-opportunities-2026-04-08/ (Reuters)]
**[[Germany|German]] shipping company [[Hapag-Lloyd]] says that it still does not plan to resume transiting the Strait of Hormuz despite the two-week ceasefire. They also say that it would need 6–8 weeks for recovery and for normal operations to resume. [https://insiderpaper.com/hapag-lloyd-wont-resume-transiting-strait-of-hormuz/ (Insider Paper)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/hapag-lloyd-estimates-extra-weekly-costs-iran-crisis-50-mln60-mln-2026-04-08/ (Reuters)]
**Oil prices plunge below [[United States dollar|US$]]95 and the [[Dow Jones Industrial Average]] surges past 1,000 after the ceasefire announcement. [https://apnews.com/article/stock-markets-trump-iran-ceasefire-oil-2fc5ac7823bea71984b3578ec36aacee (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Belarus–North Korea relations]]
**[[Belarus]] plans to open an [[List of diplomatic missions of Belarus|embassy]] in [[North Korea]] by August 1 after [[President of Belarus|president]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] visited the country in March following a decree signed by [[Prime Minister of Belarus|prime minister]] [[Alexander Turchin]]. [https://caliber.az/en/post/belarus-to-open-embassy-in-north-korea-by-august-2026 (Caliber.az)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2026 attack on Israeli consulate in Istanbul]]
**[[Turkey|Turkish]] [[General Directorate of Security (Turkey)|police]] arrest 198 suspects across 34 [[Provinces of Turkey|provinces]] in operations targeting the [[Islamic State]] following a fatal shootout outside the [[List of diplomatic missions of Israel|Israeli consulate]] in [[Istanbul]] on April 7. Several suspects are placed in [[pre-trial detention]] as part of the investigation. [https://uk.news.yahoo.com/nearly-200-arrests-turkey-attack-191450196.html (AFP via Yahoo News)]
*[[Gilgo Beach serial killings]]
**[[Rex Heuermann]] admits in court to killing eight women and discarding their bodies between 1993 and 2010 in [[New York (state)|New York]], [[United States]]. Heuermann is expected to receive a sentence of [[Life imprisonment in the United States|life in prison]] without parole when he is sentenced on June 17. [https://news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1850372-20260409.htm (AFP via RTHK)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/gilgo-beach-serial-killer-suspect-rex-heuermann-expected-plead-guilty-rcna266547 (NBC News)]
*[[Illegal drug trade in the United States]]
**A [[Federal judiciary of the United States|U.S. court]] sentences [[Jasveen Sangha]] to 15 years in [[Incarceration in the United States|prison]] for distributing [[ketamine]] that resulted in the death of actor [[Matthew Perry]] in 2023, as part of a wider investigation into a network supplying [[controlled substance]]s. Authorities also charge and sentence other individuals, including medical professionals, in connection with [[Ketamine in society and culture|the distribution of the drug]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260408-ketamine-queen-jailed-for-15-years-over-matthew-perry-drugs (AFP via France 24)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Protests against the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[Anti-war movement|Anti-war]] protesters gather outside the [[Embassy of the United States, Ottawa|U.S. embassy]] in [[Ottawa]], [[Canada]], to protest against the Iran war despite the ceasefire along with the wars in Lebanon and [[Gaza war protests|Gaza]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/ottawa/article/protesters-gather-outside-american-embassy-in-ottawa-to-oppose-wars-in-lebanon-iran/ (CTV News)]
**Around 50,000 protestors across over 150 locations, including around 30,000 outside the [[National Diet Building]] in [[Chiyoda, Tokyo|Chiyoda-ku]], [[Tokyo]], [[Japan]], protest against the war and proposals by [[Prime Minister of Japan|prime minister]] [[Sanae Takaichi]] plan to revise [[Article 9 of the Constitution of Japan|Article 9]] of the [[Constitution of Japan|constitution]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2026/04/09/world/video/japan-iran-anti-war-protests-ldn-digvid (CNN)] [https://www.kanaloco.jp/news/social/article-1262991.html (''Kanagawa Shimbun'')]
